description: This PHP source file defines the 'Featured' controller for the OpenCart catalog module. It loads product data, processes images, prices, and other product details to generate a featured products display for the storefront.

classes.name: Featured
classes.description: Controller class for handling the display of featured products in the OpenCart storefront. Extends core Controller and implements the index method to fetch and render featured products based on settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that processes the input settings, loads necessary models and language files, retrieves product information, processes images and prices, and returns the rendered view for featured products.
